job.job_description:
We are seeking a passionate and skilled Full Stack Developer to join our growing team. The ideal candidate will have the opportunity to work on our flagship product, TravelMore, as well as contribute to other diverse projects. You will collaborate closely with our cross-functional teams to design, develop, and deploy high-quality applications and services.

Requirements Key Responsibilities

Develop and maintain robust, scalable, and secure web applications using Python , Django , React , and Next.js .

Design, implement, and manage databases including PostgreSQL , MongoDB , and Redis .

Utilize AWS services for deploying and managing applications in the cloud environment.

Employ Docker for containerization to ensure consistent and efficient deployment processes.

Collaborate with product managers, designers, and other developers to translate requirements into functional features.

Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code following best practices and coding standards.

Conduct code reviews, debugging, and performance optimization to enhance application efficiency.

Participate in agile development processes, including sprint planning, stand-ups, and retrospectives.

Stay updated with emerging technologies and industry trends to continually improve skills and project outcomes.

Qualifications


1 to 3+ Years of Experience & Proficiency in Python and Django for backend development.

Strong experience with frontend technologies including React and Next.js .

Familiarity with cloud platforms, particularly AWS , and understanding of deploying applications in a cloud environment.

Experience with containerization technologies like Docker .

Solid understanding and hands-on experience with databases such as PostgreSQL , MongoDB , and Redis .

Ability to work collaboratively in a remote team setting and communicate effectively.

Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

Self-motivated with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

Prior experience in full-stack development is a plus but not mandatory; enthusiastic learners are welcome.
